keyFindings.description: resolutionText puts resolution.reason in the CLI output as it is. The resolve route only trims the reason (packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/api/ask_transitions.go:268), so a reason can hold newlines, and each later line then prints at column 0, where `dispatch search` prints its hit lines. Answer text in the same output gets a four-space indent on each later line (answerLines, line 38). The fix: indent the reason's later lines the same way through one shared helper (the split/join answerLines uses), and add a search-answer.test.ts case with a multi-line reason for both `Closed with no answer` and `Closed after an answer`.
